as_told.title: Gnostic reading that Jesus survived the crucifixion

plain: Jesus did not die on the cross, the story goes, and much more was going on behind the scenes, with the Last Supper a choreographed mystery ritual in which Jesus was sedated and then revived. The researcher Randall Carlson tells it, pointing to the writer Brian Muraresku, author of The Immortality Key, and to Joseph of Arimathea, the man in the Gospels who took Jesus's body. Michels himself, in an earlier episode, frames it as a reading found in some Gnostic, meaning early mystical Christian, interpretations, citing the scholar Elaine Pagels and the Gospels of Thomas, Luke and Matthew.
